mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stores (store_id, store_name, is_active, icon_url) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{storeName}, #{active}, #{iconUrl}) ON CONFLICT (store_id) DO UPDATE SET store_name = EXCLUDED.store_name, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, icon_url = EXCLUDED.icon_url

INSERT INTO games (game_id, title, steam_app_id, thumb_url, metacritic_score, steam_rating_pct, release_date) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{title}, #{steamAppId}, #{thumbUrl}, #{metacriticScore}, #{steamRatingPct}, #{releaseDate}) ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, steam_app_id = EXCLUDED.steam_app_id, thumb_url = EXCLUDED.thumb_url, metacritic_score = EXCLUDED.metacritic_score, steam_rating_pct = EXCLUDED.steam_rating_pct, release_date = EXCLUDED.release_date

INSERT INTO deals (deal_id, game_id, store_id, sale_price, normal_price, savings, deal_rating, currency, is_on_sale, last_change) VALUES (#{dealId}, #{gameId}, #{storeId}, #{salePrice}, #{normalPrice}, #{savings}, #{dealRating}, #{currency}, #{onSale}, #{lastChange}) ON CONFLICT (deal_id) DO UPDATE SET game_id = EXCLUDED.game_id, store_id = EXCLUDED.store_id, sale_price = EXCLUDED.sale_price, normal_price = EXCLUDED.normal_price, savings = EXCLUDED.savings, deal_rating = EXCLUDED.deal_rating, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, is_on_sale = EXCLUDED.is_on_sale, last_change = EXCLUDED.last_change
mapper.select: SELECT d.deal_id, g.steam_app_id FROM deals d JOIN games g ON g.game_id = d.game_id WHERE d.store_id = '1' AND g.steam_app_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.deal_rating DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{max}

SELECT g.game_id, g.steam_app_id FROM games g WHERE g.steam_app_id IS NOT NULL AND g.meta_fetched_at IS NULL ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(d.deal_rating) FROM deals d WHERE d.game_id = g.game_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{max}
mapper.update: UPDATE games SET genres = #{genres}, short_desc_ko = #{shortDescKo}, korean_support = #{koreanSupport}, meta_fetched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE game_id = #{gameId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_history (game_id, store_id, sale_price) SELECT d.game_id, d.store_id, d.sale_price FROM deals d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ph.sale_price FROM price_history ph WHERE ph.game_id = d.game_id AND ph.store_id = d.store_id ORDER BY ph.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) last ON TRUE WHERE last.sale_price IS DISTINCT FROM d.sale_price
mapper.select: SELECT t.genre FROM ( SELECT trim(x) AS genre, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM games g, unnest(string_to_array(g.genres, '|')) AS x WHERE g.genres IS NOT NULL AND trim(x) <> '' GROUP BY trim(x) ) t ORDER BY t.cnt DESC, t.genre

SELECT t.deal_id, t.title, t.game_id, t.store_id, t.store_name, t.sale_price, t.normal_price, t.savings, t.currency, t.krw_sale_price, t.krw_normal_price, t.thumb_url, t.genres, t.korean_support FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (regexp_replace(lower(btrim(g.title)), '\s*[:-]*\s*((digital )?deluxe|ultimate|gold|complete|definitive|legendary|goty|game of the year|collectors?|premium|enhanced|anniversary|remastered|standard)( edition)?\s*$', '')) d.deal_id, g.title, d.game_id, d.store_id, s.store_name, d.sale_price, d.normal_price, d.savings, d.currency, d.krw_sale_price, d.krw_normal_price, g.thumb_url, g.genres, g.korean_support, d.deal_rating FROM deals d JOIN games g ON g.game_id = d.game_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = d.store_id
ORDER BY regexp_replace(lower(btrim(g.title)), '\s*[:-]*\s*((digital )?deluxe|ultimate|gold|complete|definitive|legendary|goty|game of the year|collectors?|premium|enhanced|anniversary|remastered|standard)( edition)?\s*$', ''), d.sale_price ASC, d.deal_id ) t ORDER BY
t.sale_price ASC, t.deal_id t.savings DESC, t.deal_id t.deal_rating DESC NULLS LAST, t.savings DESC, t.deal_id
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(g.title)), '\s*[:-]*\s*((digital )?deluxe|ultimate|gold|complete|definitive|legendary|goty|game of the year|collectors?|premium|enhanced|anniversary|remastered|standard)( edition)?\s*$', '')) FROM deals d JOIN games g ON g.game_id = d.game_id
SELECT store_id, store_name, icon_url FROM stores WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY store_id::int
SELECT game_id, title, steam_app_id, thumb_url, metacritic_score, steam_rating_pct, release_date, genres, short_desc_ko, korean_support FROM games WHERE game_id = #{gameId}

SELECT d.deal_id, d.store_id, s.store_name, d.sale_price, d.normal_price, d.savings, d.currency, d.krw_sale_price, d.krw_normal_price FROM deals d JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = d.store_id WHERE d.game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY d.sale_price ASC, d.deal_id

SELECT g.game_id, g.title, g.thumb_url, MIN(d.sale_price) AS min_sale_price, 'USD' AS currency, COUNT(DISTINCT d.store_id) AS store_count, string_agg(DISTINCT s.store_name, '|') AS store_names FROM games g JOIN deals d ON d.game_id = g.game_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = d.store_id WHERE g.title ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' GROUP BY g.game_id, g.title, g.thumb_url ORDER BY min_sale_price ASC, g.title LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.game_id) FROM games g JOIN deals d ON d.game_id = g.game_id WHERE g.title ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'

SELECT g.game_id, g.title, g.thumb_url, MIN(d.sale_price) AS min_sale_price, 'USD' AS currency, COUNT(DISTINCT d.store_id) AS store_count, string_agg(DISTINCT s.store_name, '|') AS store_names FROM games g JOIN deals d ON d.game_id = g.game_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = d.store_id WHERE g.steam_app_id IN #{id} GROUP BY g.game_id, g.title, g.thumb_url ORDER BY min_sale_price ASC, g.title
